_help: Hand-maintained classification of the frontend calls that openapi.json does not have (scripts/contract-gaps.mjs reads it).
Key: "METHOD /v1/path" with every variable part as {} (the scan prints the keys; run `node scripts/contract-gaps.mjs --check`).
Value: { app: mobile | console | mobile+console, class, owner, pr?, milestone?, fix?, note? }.

class: pending-pr (an open or stacked PR builds it) | fix-frontend (the frontend changes) | fix-backend (the backend lacks it and no spec says when: a frontend proposal or an unspecified view; spec it, build it or drop it) | later (a spec exists, a milestone builds it) | drop (mocked by decision, no real endpoint).
owner: yash (frontend) | prathamesh (backend). Milestones: MS-A 13 Dec 2026, MS-B 24 Jan, MS-C 21 Feb, MS-D 7 Mar (handbook 14); a module's sprint is in its spec header.
Delete an entry when its fix lands (--check reports a stale entry). extra_fixes lists mismatches the scan cannot see.

PATCH /v1/cycles/{}/meals.fix: F1: useSwapMeal sends PATCH; send PUT (same body { date, slot }); change the mock handler too.
PATCH /v1/cycles/{}/meals.note: M3 §3.2 renamed it to PUT; blocks the MS-A meal-swap flow.

PATCH /v1/admin/festivals/{}.fix: F3: PATCH (and DELETE) /v1/admin/festivals/{day}/{code}/{region}, not a single id; the run's days become one call each.

POST /v1/admin/reconciliation/{}/credit.fix: F4: POST /v1/admin/reconciliation/{id}/resolve with { note } (moves no money; the wallet credit is not an action).

POST /v1/admin/reconciliation/{}/investi.fix: F4: same resolve call; the spec has no 'investigating' state.

POST /v1/admin/reconciliation/check.fix: F4: drop the 'Check now' button; the hourly Razorpay check is a job. Ask for an admin trigger only if wanted.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/tiffin-menus.note: M2 §3.4: the review list, every status, at the mock's path. Supersedes F5 for this page: GET /v1/tiffin-menus (M4 §3.5) lists approved menus only.

GET /v1/tiffin-offers.fix: Call GET /v1/tiffin-menus?date=&meal= and map the menus to offers (M4 §3.5 table 'Mock today'). Built on main (#317).
GET /v1/tiffin-offers.note: The cycle does not carry offers.

GET /v1/orders/{}/tiffin.fix: Read OrderOut.tiffin and OrderOut.kitchen (on main, #319), then GET /v1/partners/{kitchen.partner_id}/card for the cook.

GET /v1/orders/{}/rating.fix: GET /v1/ratings?order_id={id}. The endpoint ships with the M8 stack.

POST /v1/orders/{}/rating.fix: POST /v1/ratings with { order_id, stars } and an Idempotency-Key. The endpoint ships with the M8 stack.

POST /v1/hubs/{}/cutoff/run.fix: Remove 'Run cut-off now' from the cut-off page: M4 replaced it with the 21:00 job (cutoff_lock), which is operator-only.
POST /v1/hubs/{}/cutoff/run.note: M4 spec endpoint table, row POST /v1/internal/jobs/cutoff_lock.

GET /v1/admin/hubs.fix: The spec has POST only. List with GET /v1/hubs and read each with GET /v1/hubs/{id}; show what those carry.
GET /v1/admin/hubs.note: M6 §3.1. If address, people and slots are needed in one list, that is a new backend ask.

GET /v1/public/societies.fix: Drop the public society list from the landing page; a society page is GET /v1/public/societies/{slug}.

GET /v1/public/cooks/{}.fix: Use GET /v1/partners/{id}/card (M8 owns know-your-cook). It needs sign-in; decide whether the QR page stays public.
GET /v1/public/cooks/{}.note: M12 §3.7: public cook profiles are M8's card.

GET /v1/earnings/certificate.note: M8 §3.7 is an outline, 'refined after MS-B'.

POST /v1/admin/societies.note: M9 §3.1 lists POST /v1/admin/societies (frozen for S1) but main has only PATCH /v1/admin/societies/{id}.

GET /v1/public/societies/{}.note: M12 §3.7, by slug; the shape differs (no captain_name, adds progress_bp, join_url).

GET /v1/hubs/{}/delivery-days.note: M3 §3.5 (drafted 2026-10-25): every society of the hub with its status; no not_live list.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/cycles.note: Dropped (M3 §3.5, owner 2026-10-25): the Cut-off page (M3 §3.4) has the counts per delivery date; take the Cycles page out of the nav.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/fairness.note: M8 §3.8 (drafted 2026-10-25): lambda_paise and the latest assignment runs; no kitchens table.

PUT /v1/hubs/{}/fairness-weight.note: Dropped (M8 §3.8, owner 2026-10-25): λ is PARTNERS_FAIRNESS_LAMBDA, chosen by the offline λ sweep (M10 §3.5, handbook 08); remove the page's Change control.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/settings.fix: Read GET /v1/hubs/{hub_id} (M6 §3.1, HubOut, ETag = version). Map hub_id → id, hub_name → name; the clock's receiving, packing, dispatch and surplus rows → timings; show status, address, procurement_buffer_pct and pre_live_box_fee_paise. Remove switches (ai_planner, auto_approve, tiffins, upi_autopay), languages, quiet_hours and changes: no backend has them. The other clock rows are fixed job times (handbook 10 §10.4): console copy, not data.
GET /v1/hubs/{}/settings.note: M6 §3.1. Admin only in the nav, as today.

PATCH /v1/hubs/{}/settings.fix: PATCH /v1/admin/hubs/{hub_id} with If-Match (the version from the GET) and any of { name, address, location, service_area, status, timings, procurement_buffer_pct, pre_live_box_fee_paise }; 412 request.version_mismatch → reload. No switches, languages or quiet hours; the change history is the audit log, not shown.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/staff.note: M1 §3.6: HubStaff with names and masked phones; no today or last_week_paise.

POST /v1/hubs/{}/staff-invitations.note: Dropped (M1 §3.6, owner 2026-10-25): staff roles through POST /v1/admin/user-roles (admin; a new number gets a pending grant), riders and packers through M8's POST /v1/hubs/{id}/partner-applications (hub manager); kitchens and captains apply in the app. Remove the Invite sheet from the franchise Staff page.

GET /v1/admin/plans.note: M3 §3.5: AdminPlan with state and subscriber_count; read-only (plan writes dropped).

POST /v1/admin/plans.note: Dropped (M3 §3.5, owner 2026-10-25): plans are seeded and a fee is a price. Keep the Plans page read-only even when GET /v1/admin/plans answers.

GET /v1/admin/refunds.note: M5 §3.8 (drafted 2026-10-25): read-only RefundRow list, served by M4's router from billing.api.order_refunds; no status=pending queue.

POST /v1/admin/refunds/{}/{}.note: Dropped (M5 §3.8, owner 2026-10-25): refunds are automatic (M5 §3.3); disputes are M4's issue triage (M4 §3.6). The Refunds page becomes a read-only list.

GET /v1/admin/societies.note: M9 §3.9 (drafted 2026-10-25): the staff list with hub, households and the edited fields; with_unassigned is admin-only.

PATCH /v1/admin/society-requests/{}.note: M9 §3.9: only { status: "received" }, the undo of a duplicate.

POST /v1/admin/society-requests/{}/accep.note: M9 §3.9: creates a prospect society through POST /v1/admin/societies's create path (itself later, MS-A).

DELETE /v1/admin/user-roles/{}.note: M1 §3.6: revokes a staff grant or cancels a pending one; partner and customer roles are 409 identity.role_not_removable.

POST /v1/tiffin-menus/{}/approve.note: M2 §3.4 (drafted 2026-10-25): catalog_editor and admin; only approved menus are bookable.

POST /v1/tiffin-menus/{}/reopen.note: M2 §3.4: from approved or sent_back, before order_by.

GET /v1/hubs/{}/shortages.note: M6 §3.6 (drafted 2026-10-25): ShortItem gains short_by; outcome is substitute | refund.

GET /v1/budget-lock/preferences.note: Dropped (M3 §11, owner 2026-10-25): the planner only swaps to cheaper (M3 §3.1); the app already hides the question. Remove useBudgetPreferences and the when_over PUT.

POST /v1/mandates.note: UPI Autopay is not in this phase; M5 §3.7 keeps /v1/mandates out of openapi.json. Hide the Autopay choice behind a flag.

GET /v1/intel/experiments.note: Experiments are cut (M12 header, owner 2026-10-09); the page stays on its mock.

extra_fixes.fix: Mock role grants use slug scope_ids; use the seed UUIDs (hub 0199a000-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001, Sunrise Towers ...b001) so the same code runs on both.

M12 §3.3 ships (GET /v1/analytics/hubs/{id}/today, /kpis, /societies) and replaces the mocks. GET /v1/hubs/{id}/ops-board becomes /v1/analytics/hubs/{id}/today: timestamps and HH:MM, formatted by the console; compose the status line from steps; no markers or route; attention is { kind, count, oldest_at, due_at, link } (copy and tone from kind; issues link to /hub/issues). GET /v1/analytics/customer-summary becomes /v1/analytics/societies (the console totals items and counts status unlocking as joining; paused_households is in the row). /kpis needs data_source real|synthetic, returns periods (ISO dates) and series.<key>.
Add the catalog_editor role (seed person Rekha Joshi, +91 98000 01013): its home, nav sections (catalog and prices) and the sign-in button.
GET /v1/hubs ships now: update the comments that say it is a 404, and the mocks README (it says API port 8010 and console port 3160; real mode is 8000 and 3000, see docs/SETUP.md 'Real mode').

M9 §3.5 ships: build against its shapes, not the mock's (M9 §3.5 'Mock today'). POST /v1/admin/ngos takes { name, kind, hub_ids, accepts, registration_ref, verified, status, note } (coordinators are M1 role grants) and PATCH needs If-Match; GET /v1/ngo-handoffs is Page[Handoff] with `report` (`summary` is structured; `open_batches` is GET /v1/ngo-handoffs/ready); POST /v1/ngo-handoffs takes { ngo_id, hub_id, kind, donation_ids | offer_ids | meals, photo_keys (1 to 3 handoff_photo uploads), people_reached, handed_at, note } with an Idempotency-Key; a drive's ngo_id may be set.
